messages:
elaine.s: Hey team — BridgeTech POC is ready to sign but procurement wants the signer reassigned and legal flagged multiple redlines (MSA + DPA + HSM addendum). OrderForm OF-2026-0423.
marco.legal: Please drop the redlines here. HSM + EU DPA tend to be the sticky parts.
elaine.s: Uploaded: https://drive.redwood/bridgetech/OF-2026-0423-redlines.pdf. They added a clause for KMS attestation.
josh.se: Quick Q on billing: Dedicated 4xA100 trial for 30 days, right? That changes invoicing and usage caps.
elaine.s: Correct — Dedicated 4xA100, 30d trial, asked for burst capacity and an overall usage cap.
ton y.finance: Finance needs PO number and remit-to address (payables@bridgetech.com or procurement@bridgetech.com). Net30 default; procurement asked for Net45.
elaine.s: Procurement asked to replace signer eliza@bridgetech.com with procurement@bridgetech.com and to countersign after we accept.
marco.legal: We should set DocuSign to sequential signing: procurement -> Redwood legal. For KMS attestation, propose redline: "Customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) permitted; Redwood will support customer attestation to SOC2 Type II or equivalent. Specific HSM vendor details to be agreed in Appendix A."
marco.legal: ```Suggested MSA snippet: \"Customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) permitted; Redwood will support customer attestation to SOC2 Type II or equivalent. Specific HSM vendor requirements to be documented in Appendix A.\"```
meera.security: Security questionnaire flagged S3 cross-account copy, retention windows, and syslog forwarding. Created SQ-788 to get clarifications from BridgeTech on PII in logs and external SIEM. ETA EOD.
josh.se: If Dedicated is deployed in EU region we can meet residency — include "region: eu-west-1" in the OF. Also will validate any HSM vendor compatibility if they insist on names.
elaine.s: Draft OF snippet for envelope: ```OrderForm: OF-2026-0423
Plan: Dedicated Standard (4xA100)
Region: eu-west-1
Start: 2026-04-15
Billing: Net30 (pending)
PO: <pending>```
docusign-bot: Envelope created: env_7801 for OF-2026-0423. Signing order set to sequential. Link: https://docusign/redwood/env_7801
ton y.finance: If PO arrives with Net45 and ARR > $120k we need exec approval. Elaine, confirm PO number asap.
marco.legal: If attestation requires deliverables/tests, scope in Appendix B (SOW), do not change core SLA. I'll attach our redline PDF to the envelope and set signer assignment: procurement@bridgetech.com then Redwood legal (marco.legal).
meera.security: If logs contain PII we need tighter DPA language — will include that in SQ-788 questions.
josh.se: I'll validate Dedicated config limits and any extra setup needed for HSM in the trial by noon.
elaine.s: Owners: @marco.legal = legal redline & countersign, @meera.security = SQ follow-up, @tony.finance = billing & PO terms, @josh.se = Dedicated verification. I'll update CRM and attach this thread. :thumbsup:
marco.legal: FYI — if BridgeTech insists on naming a specific HSM vendor we'll loop in SEs for compatibility and potential SOW.
elaine.s: Thanks all — waiting for PO + SQ answers before finalizing envelope. Will update when signed. End.
